meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 即可添加 WhatsApp 频道:直连 WhatsApp Web、无 Chat SDK 桥接,用二维码或配对码认证。区分共享/专用号码:共享模式只处理自聊,不碰他人消息;专用模式所有消息归机器人,写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 WhatsApp 频道、让 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp,或询问如何连接 WhatsApp 时触发。接管后会先做号码安全检查(专用/共享)。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp
say.note: 会先问你用专用还是共享号码。
需要提供手机号,在手机上输入 8 位码。

say.text: 添加 WhatsApp 频道,用我的共享号码
say.note: 会先显示账户风险警告,需确认继续。

howto.what_en: This skill adds a WhatsApp channel via native Baileys (direct Web connection, no SDK bridge). Authenticates via QR or pairing code. Shared mode: only your self-chat, ignores other messages. Dedicated mode: all messages go to the bot. Mode is written to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a WhatsApp channel, connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp, or ask how to link WhatsApp. It starts with a mandatory number-safety check (dedicated vs shared).

say_en.text: Add NanoClaw to WhatsApp for me.
say_en.note: It will first ask dedicated vs shared number.

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp using a pairing code.
say_en.note: Needs your phone number; enter the 8-character code on your phone.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel with my shared number.
say_en.note: A risk warning will show; you must confirm to continue.
